rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality full/expanded blastocyst with favorable ICM/TE and thin zona, while appropriately noting single-image limitations; slight uncertainty remains because it leans on the reported grade and questions 3AA vs 4AA staging.

Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, response to stimulation, endometriosis, smoking, prior IVF failure, semen parameters, BMI, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong morphology and cycle factors improve prognosis, while age-related aneuploidy, endometriosis, and smoking temper expectations; the implantation estimate follows from these points.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice, including SET, caution about fresh transfer in high responders, and avoiding low-evidence add-ons; minor caveat is some speculative discussion without full cycle hormone data.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, smoking cessation, transfer-condition checks, uterine reassessment if repeated failure, and when to discuss PGT-A or endometriosis-focused strategies.
